method: Review generated pages against original source, not the model's declaration. Each item is 0 or 1; absence is a miss. Unsupported certainty is recorded separately. One trial cannot establish general accuracy or latency.

criteria.expected: createOrder calls applyDiscount then shippingFee with the discounted amount; final total adds discounted amount and shipping.
normal 0%, silver 3%, gold 7%, vip 12%; unknown grades fail.
Discounted amount is floored to a multiple of 10, not ordinary rounding.
Base shipping is 3000 below 50000, zero at or above 50000, evaluated after discount for orders.
jeju/island add 4500 even when base shipping is free.
received -> paid/cancelled; paid -> shipped/cancelled; shipped -> delivered; delivered/cancelled terminal.
empty order, integer nonnegative amount, unknown grade and invalid transition checks are scoped to their actual functions; item fields are not falsely described as fully validated.
exportRow is a separate CSV export of total, shipping, extra, status. Its 4500 constant is independent of shippingFee; it is not called by createOrder.
Documents npm test/node --test and test coverage without claiming execution or comprehensive validation.
Behavior is linked to real current source locations/Claims; navigation-map entries alone are not accepted as proof.
